name: resolve_asset
description: Map free-text/jargon to a formal asset_id.

name: prognostic_tool
description: RUL, failure probability and SHAP attribution for an asset.

name: abnormality_tool
description: Independent dynamic abnormality detection from sensor deviations and trend.

name: rag_tool
description: Retrieve SOP/manual/incident text, optionally filtered to an asset_id.

name: inventory_tool
description: Spare-part stock and procurement lead times for an asset.

name: sql_query_tool
description: Run a read-only SELECT over tables: assets, sensors, delays, incidents, parts. Returns the SQL and rows.

name: delay_history_tool
description: Production delay history for an asset.

name: risk_score_tool
description: Deterministic priority score and constraint flag for an asset.

name: alert_dispatch_tool
description: Dispatch a real-time, role-routed alert for a high-risk asset. Omit recipients to auto-route by severity (critical->supervisor, high->reliability, else maintenance); or pass role (maintenance|reliability|supervisor) or an explicit recipients string.

name: task_closure_tool
description: Check the compliance checklist for a work order; blocks closure if items missing.
